description.value:
An afterimage stands where you were. The first attack made against you each round requires the attacker to succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the attack misses.

Not yet automated. Pathfinder settles an attack's outcome before a module can see it, so cancelling a hit after the fact is not something a rule element or a rider can do — it needs the attack interrupted on the way in. Roll the flat check at the table for now.
